result.summary: Found 1 critical accessibility issue: the promotional banner text is white on a very light background and nearly unreadable, plus a minor formatting inconsistency in delivery time badges.

issues.description: Promotional banner '3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout...' uses white text on a very light mint background, making the text nearly invisible and unreadable due to extremely low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Change banner text to a dark color such as dark green or black, or darken the banner background to meet WCAG AA contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1

issues.description: Delivery time badges use inconsistent formatting: '15-25 min' and '20-30 min' without spaces vs '20-30 min' with spaces on the third card.
issues.suggestion: Standardize time range formatting across all badges, e.g., consistently use '15-25 min' without spaces around the dash
